messages:
vikram: Heads-up — scheduling a short maintenance 00:30-01:30 UTC to retry NIC firmware on saturn-21 and saturn-22 (us-west2). rolling node drains + soft reboots. goal is <30m capacity impact and no Dedicated SLA regression.

sara: OK. roughly how much GPU capacity will be affected and when exactly per rack?

vikram: estimate ~8% total GPU capacity lost at peak while we warm-backfill. We'll do per-node stagger: start saturn-21 nodes at 00:30, saturn-22 stream starts 00:45. never reboot same AZ host group concurrently.

chris: can we use 5m inter-node gaps and run kv-cache preseed after each node comes back? that reduced tail latencies last patch.

vikram: yes — drain -> soft reboot -> nvlink sanity -> kv-preseed -> uncordon. 5m gap between nodes in a stream. two streams in parallel (one per rack) but AZ-safe.

jen: I can own canaries and rollback. add alert if error-rate or p95 latency > 2x baseline for 10m and page SRE.

vikram: will add thresholds to runbook. ops-bot: create incident stub and page when thresholds hit.

ops-bot: Incident stub created INC-20231107-1709881234. Paging policy: oncall-eng -> oncall-sre if >10% errors.

sara: tenant comms? Dedicated tenants might notice degraded perf. Recommend alerting top 5 tenants with >95th percentile SLAs.

chris: agree. no billing exposure but performance fallback to gradient pool possible. jen, please send a short tenant note: window + mitigation + who to contact.

jen: will send comm now and schedule follow-up if rollback required. using template from #customer-success.

sara: checklist after each node bring-up: `nvidia-smi`, `dmesg | tail -n50`, `nvlink-health check`, run 3-min perf probe against seeded kv-cache.

vikram: added to runbook at /runbooks/infra/saturn-nic-retry.md. also enabling quiet-window so scheduled heavy batches won't start during maintenance.

chris: also patch scheduler route to avoid placing new long-seq requests on these racks for 1h post-maint (prevent cold-cache storms).

vikram: will tag racks with `gradual-backoff=1h` at start time. ops-bot: apply tag when maintenance starts.

ops-bot: Tagging queued: `tag-rack saturn-21 saturn-22 maintenance=1709881234`.

jen: I'll monitor canaries and post brief status every 10m into this thread. I have rollback playbook ready.

sara: standing by for rollback signal. thanks team.

vikram: rolling at 00:30 UTC. will post a postmortem link here after window. :thumbsup:
